title: Overcoming Technical Obstacles
grammar: Combining -andó/-endő modifiers with instrumental postpositional phrases
goal: I can build complex prenominal modifier chains combining postpositional phrases with -andó/-endő participles
I can express how technical obstacles are diagnosed and eliminated (kiküszöböl, elhárít, áthidal)
I can translate dense Hungarian technical specifications into clear English and vice versa
